text_en: Praise the Lord ! Happy are those who fear the Lord , who greatly delight in his commandments.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 凡敬畏上主的人，真是有福， 喜欢他诫命的人，真是有福！

text_en: Their descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
text_cn: 他的子孙在世上必要强盛， 义人的后代必要受到赞颂。

text_en: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.
text_cn: 他家中必有权势财产， 他的仁义必存留永远。

text_en: They rise in the darkness as a light for the upright; they are gracious, merciful, and righteous.
text_cn: 他富有仁爱，慈悲而又公道， 像光明在暗处向义人照耀。

text_en: It is well with those who deal generously and lend, who conduct their affairs with justice.
text_cn: 乐善好施的人必蒙受祝福， 他以正义处理自己的事务。

text_en: For the righteous will never be moved; they will be remembered forever.
text_cn: 因为他永远不会失足抖颤， 义人必要受到永远的纪念。

text_en: They are not afraid of evil tidings; their hearts are firm, secure in the Lord .
text_cn: 噩耗的凶信，不会使他惊慌， 因为他仰赖上主心志坚强。

text_en: Their hearts are steady, they will not be afraid; in the end they will look in triumph on their foes.
text_cn: 直到看见他的仇敌蒙羞， 他的心志坚强无惧无忧。

text_en: They have distributed freely, they have given to the poor; their righteousness endures forever; their horn is exalted in honor.
text_cn: 他散财而周济贫苦的人。 他的仁义必会万世留存， 他的头角高举必受光荣。

text_en: The wicked see it and are angry; they gnash their teeth and melt away; the desire of the wicked comes to nothing.
text_cn: 罪人见到必要愤恨满腔， 咬自己的牙齿，焦灼难当， 恶人们的希望终必丧亡。
